values.note: Columbia County: regular campsite $25/night (the booking catalog charges every site $25, any residency); seniors 55+ $22; primitive $15 per tent, group primitive $50 (non-profit groups, arranged with the park supervisor). The park's entry fee ($3 per car or truck a day, $6 with a boat; $30 annual pass) is listed separately and the county doesn't say whether campers pay it. Dump station $5. Cancelling 3+ days out costs one night; inside 3 days no refund.

values.note: Three camping areas: Area 1 36 sites (01-35 plus 05a), Area 2 15 (36-51), Area 3 10 (52-61). The county's site descriptions give lengths of 40-80 ft (two sites unstated), so every site takes a 23-ft rig; the Area 1 map marks some pull-throughs. 27 primitive sites are booked separately.

note: Columbia County (GA) park on Clarks Hill/J. Strom Thurmond Lake at Appling. Three camping areas on the lake plus primitive sites; boat ramps, beach, disc golf. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Columbia County's park page and Rec1 booking catalog: $25 every site (seniors $22), 61 sites with water and 30/50A, showers in each area, dump ($5), online booking. Added sites 40-80 ft (max 80), pull-throughs, the area breakdown and the Rec1 URL. Split candidate not supported (see flags). Note cleaned.
flags: Split candidate: not a split on the evidence. All three areas are reached through the one Wildwood Park entrance (3780 Dogwood Lane; one park page, one Rec1 'Wildwood Park' tab) and sit within the park's lakeside band. On imagery the RV loop on the peninsula south of the boat ramp (~33.6466,-82.2782, RVs visible; matches the Area 1 map) is roughly 500-750 m from the wooded areas west of the park's open field (~33.649,-82.284), where Areas 2 and 3 appear to be; heavy canopy meant I could not pin Areas 2 and 3 site-by-site, so those distances are approximate, but none approaches 1 km with a separate entrance.

Pin: 33.6485,-82.2860 falls in forest west of the park's open field, not on a site loop I could identify; Area 1 (36 of the 61 sites) is centred about 750 m ESE at ~33.6466,-82.2782. Consider moving the pin to Area 1.
Fees: the park charges an entry fee ($3/vehicle/day, $6 with a boat) but the county doesn't say whether campers pay it on top of the $25; left in fees.note rather than fees.entrance.
